en: Black‑and‑white view from a cliffside building with arched windows and awnings, perched dramatically on a rocky precipice. A small open cable car descends on steep cables from near the building toward the valley below. In the distance lies a broad valley filled with a dense town or small city and surrounding agricultural fields, ringed by mountains under a hazy sky. The image has a white border and the aged, slightly speckled look of an early 20th‑century printed postcard. No visible caption or printed text appears on the image side.
